name: Maiden☆Breeder 2
source:
There used to be three tribes here competing over supremacy in constant wars. Through the help of a sacred girl they learned how to reproduce without men. The descendants of that girl are called maidens and treated as pets. In this city of maiden many breeders compete today. Main character vows to become number one of them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]

What you can do on weekdays depends on the item. You can't sing without a microphone, and you can't do H without a bed. There are more than 100 kinds of various items. Schedule well and grow to your liking. Put together combos in public performances to earn more money!
translation:
過去，這裡有三個部族為爭奪霸權而連年交戰。後來在一名聖女幫助下，她們學會了無需男性便可繁衍的方法。聖女的後裔被稱為「Maiden」，並被當作寵物飼養。如今，在這座Maiden之城裡，許多培育師彼此競爭。主角發誓要成為其中的第一名。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]

平日能做什麼取決於持有的道具：沒有麥克風就不能唱歌，沒有床就不能進行H活動。遊戲中共有一百多種道具。妥善安排日程，把少女培養成自己喜歡的樣子吧。在公開演出中將不同動作串成連招，賺取更多金錢！
